explanation: Shrunk scenario has 2 massive bodies (m~10.9 and 18.2), high G=4.62 and large dt=0.0333 (~1/30 upper limit). Bodies approach to 0.46 at step 22 (within softening 0.3) where forces ∝1/(r^2+eps^2)^{1.5} vary steeply. Adaptive substeps max 30 per outer step (30 at step22, 27 at 21) insufficient to resolve rapid force change, so leapfrog integration accumulates energy error: energy ~555.5 at steps 0/19/20, drops to 548 at step21 and to 415.2 at step22, change 140.3 exceeds allowed ~75, violating energy_conserved. Reducing dt to 0.005 with same steps/G/bodies eliminates the violation, confirming dt/integration accuracy is causal.
vision_note: Steps 19 to 21 show two blue bodies on converging trajectories getting progressively closer, nearly vertically aligned by step 21. At step 22 they reach an extremely close near-collision and appear to overlap/touch with a sudden jump in relative position compared to the smooth approach before.
